description: An Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning-enabled surveillance system was launched by the Tamil Nadu forest department in a bid to prevent elephant deaths on railway tracks. The system is in force in Coimbatore division.
body_lead: Tamil Nadu to use Artificial Intelligence to avert elephant deaths on railway tracks An Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning-enabled surveillance system was launched by the Tamil Nadu forest department in a bid to prevent elephant deaths on railway tracks. The system is in force in Coimbatore division. The Tamil Nadu forest department on Friday launched its ambitious Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning-enabled surveillance system to prevent the death of elephants on railway tracks.
